headline: Yugi's Best Cards
title: Yugi's Best Cards in Yu-Gi-Oh | Top 5 Explained
video_script: Here are Yugi Mutou's best cards. Number 5: Dark Magician, his signature card, with two thousand five hundred attack. Number 4: Dark Magician Girl, who gains three hundred attack for each Dark Magician in the Graveyard. Number 3: Kuriboh, discard it to take no battle damage from an attack. Number 2: Black Luster Soldier, a three thousand attack Ritual Monster. Number 1: and Exodia, hold all five pieces and you win the Duel. Whose deck should I cover next? Comment below!

joke: Yugi's deck has more plot armour than my whole collection.
